breaking.change: Text fragments are gone. A link's fragment is an id again: `#Rules:~:text=gate` names the element whose id is that whole string, so it marks, scrolls to and targets nothing, and `::target-text` rules are refused by name. A plain `#id` link still makes its element `:target` and scrolls it into view.
breaking.fix: Link to the passage's element by id. To mark words in it, register them with `og.ui.setHighlight` and style them with a `::highlight(<name>)` rule.
